feature: PS-ANS otomatis dan pemajuan next_processing_date setelah eAN (SMS/email) terkirim, termasuk saat retry
note: Setelah SMS atau email AN berhasil terkirim, job eNotification memanggil psHelper.processPS(noticeNo, 'ANS') lalu memajukan next_processing_date ke hari ini; retry job melakukan hal sama saat kirim ulang berhasil. Story OCMS10.6/10.7 hanya meminta pengiriman notifikasi, tidak menyebut penangguhan PS-ANS sesudahnya. Mungkin dicakup story lain di Epic OCMS10/OCMS11; perlu dicek ke URA.
note_en: After an AN SMS or email is sent successfully, the eNotification job calls psHelper.processPS(noticeNo, 'ANS') and then moves next_processing_date to today; the retry job does the same on a successful resend. Stories OCMS10.6/10.7 only ask for sending the notification and do not mention the PS-ANS suspension afterwards. May be covered by another story in Epic OCMS10/OCMS11; to be checked with URA.

feature: Pencatatan dan tracking letter AN (ocms_an_letter), reset letter_address, dan PS-ANS setelah letter AN dikirim ke Toppan
note: Setelah stage ANL, code menulis satu baris per notice ke ocms_an_letter (data owner, alamat, tanggal surat), menerapkan PS-ANS, memajukan next_processing_date, dan mereset letter_address. Story OCMS10.9 hanya meminta pengiriman letter ke vendor; tracking dan penangguhan itu tidak disebut. Pengaman ke pengiriman ganda (NOT IN ocms_an_letter) bergantung pada tabel ini.
note_en: After the ANL stage, the code writes one row per notice to ocms_an_letter (owner data, address, letter date), applies PS-ANS, moves next_processing_date forward and resets letter_address. Story OCMS10.9 only asks for sending the letter to the vendor; this tracking and suspension is not mentioned. The guard against double sending (NOT IN ocms_an_letter) depends on this table.
